thesis: The most valuable conversion mechanism on this site is the coverage check, which is being undermined by competing CTAs and a broken pricing page, causing users to abandon before seeing plans.

findings.title: Conflicting value propositions
findings.summary: Two different primary headlines dilute the core message about reliability and simplicity.
findings.problem: Two different primary headlines dilute the core message about reliability and simplicity.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Reliable Internet That Just Works Anywhere in the U.S.; notes: Single combined headline.
findings.evidence: The page's main headline reads “Reliable Internet That Works Anywhere in the U.S”. | The page's main headline reads “Internet That Just Works”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Pricing page error
findings.summary: Direct navigation to /pricing returns an error, dead-ending users and preventing them from seeing plans.
findings.problem: Direct navigation to /pricing returns an error, dead-ending users and preventing them from seeing plans.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Fix route or redirect to working page.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Two-step form before value
findings.summary: Users must complete two sequential forms before seeing any plan details, adding friction.
findings.problem: Users must complete two sequential forms before seeing any plan details, adding friction.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Single coverage check; notes: Reduce to one step or show plans/pricing first.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Pricing inconsistency across pages
findings.summary: Conflicting one-time fees and monthly rates across plan pages undermine price clarity.
findings.problem: Conflicting one-time fees and monthly rates across plan pages undermine price clarity.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Standardize pricing across all pages.
findings.evidence: Prices shown on the page: $99.95/month $129.95/month $99.95/mo $0.00 $99.95 $99.99 | A section heading reads “$0.00 (one-time)”. | A section heading reads “$99.99 (one-time)”.
findings.analysts_agreeing: Message Clarity, Trust & Social Proof, Pricing & Cost Transparency, Navigation & Information Scent
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Ambiguous one-time costs
findings.summary: One-time amounts are shown without labeling what they cover, creating uncertainty about equipment ownership.
findings.problem: One-time amounts are shown without labeling what they cover, creating uncertainty about equipment ownership.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Label each one-time fee and state equipment ownership.
findings.evidence: A section heading reads “$0.00 (one-time)”. | A section heading reads “$99.99 (one-time)”. | Prices shown on the page: $99.95/month $129.95/month $99.95/mo $0.00 $99.95 $99.99
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Repeated identical headings
findings.summary: Repeated identical headings across pages and sections confuse visitors about their location.
findings.problem: Repeated identical headings across pages and sections confuse visitors about their location.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Unique headings per page; notes: Use descriptive, unique headings.
findings.evidence: The page's main headline reads “Let's Get You the Right Internet”. | The page's main headline reads “What Best Describes Your Time on the Road?”. | The page's main headline reads “How Do You Use the Internet at Home?”. | A section heading reads “How It Works”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Competing coverage CTAs
findings.summary: Multiple competing coverage-check CTAs split user attention and obscure the primary action.
findings.problem: Multiple competing coverage-check CTAs split user attention and obscure the primary action.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Single 'Check Coverage' CTA; notes: Consolidate all coverage entry points into one primary CTA.
findings.evidence: 7 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “CHECK COVERAGE”, “CHECK IF IT WORKS AT MY ADDRESS”, “SEE MY OPTIONS”, “GET STARTED”, “START CHAT”, “SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR”, “CHECK MY COVERAGE”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Vague qualification claim
findings.summary: Claim of universal qualification lacks specifics, leaving offer unclear.
findings.problem: Claim of universal qualification lacks specifics, leaving offer unclear.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Provide specific coverage, speeds, and plan options.
findings.evidence: A section heading reads “You qualify for everything”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Unsupported trust badge
findings.summary: Trust badge 'SHOP WITH CONFIDENCE' lacks supporting guarantee or security details.
findings.problem: Trust badge 'SHOP WITH CONFIDENCE' lacks supporting guarantee or security details.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add guarantee terms, return window, security certifications.
findings.evidence: A section heading reads “SHOP WITH CONFIDENCE”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Duplicate page titles
findings.summary: Identical page titles across pages weaken information scent and confuse navigation.
findings.problem: Identical page titles across pages weaken information scent and confuse navigation.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Unique descriptive titles per page.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift
